Product Changelog Timeline

Changelog

Every build that has gone out, newest first. Version 1.0 is in App Store review; the build number beside it is the TestFlight build, which is where the work lands first.

1.0.0 202608012324 Latest 1 August 2026
  • A curated list of real places. Suggested venues now appear when you fill in "Where?" — real named places, not just "Restaurant". The list is edited live rather than compiled into the app, so somewhere that closes is a correction, not an App Store submission.
1.0.0 202608012232 1 August 2026
  • Notifications you control. Five kinds, each with its own switch. Nothing is muted for you and nothing is switched on behind your back.
  • Two notifications that were missing. You now hear when a plan is called off and why, and you get asked afterwards whether a plan actually happened.
  • A weekly nudge naming the one group that has gone longest without a plan — never more than a single message, and silent when something is already booked.
  • Location, scoped to one plan. Share where you are for the hours around a plan you both agreed to. One point per tap rather than a trail, and it is deleted when the plan is over.
  • The app badge counted the wrong things — it missed exactly the plans that were mid-negotiation and waiting on you.
1.0.0 202608011143 → 202608011933 1 August 2026
  • Plans can carry something riding on them. Both people stake points on a plan happening, and following through pays it back. Never one at the other's expense.
  • Invite someone to a single plan. A one-off code that admits them to that plan and nothing else — not to your groups, not to anything after it.
  • A reliability score, worked out from plans that happened rather than stored as a verdict. Deliberately not shown inside a couple.
  • Counter-suggestions move the plan. Suggesting "Sunday instead?" now carries the new time, so accepting it actually reschedules rather than leaving the old date in place.
  • The home, calendar and activity screens no longer flash an empty state before their content arrives.
  • Plan detail was cramped and jumped as it loaded. Rebuilt so it settles in one pass.
1.0.0 202607311307 → 202607312105 31 July 2026
  • "Did it happen?" — the app asks after a plan, and that answer is what everything about reliability is built on.
  • Cancelling records why instead of quietly deleting the plan, so "called off three times running" can eventually mean something.
  • Calendar clash checks. A proposed time is compared against your calendar on the device. Read-only, opt-in, and nothing about your events is uploaded.
  • Progress survives a new phone. Achievements and history are backed up, not just the numbers on top of them.
  • Levels and goals per activity — progress in cooking is not progress in travel.
1.0.0 202607302101 → 202607310115 30 July 2026
  • Named groups, each with its own invite code. With more than one group the app could previously show the code for the wrong one.
  • Dating and Chill joined the plan categories, with a safeguard so a category added later can never make a plan silently disappear on an older version of the app.
  • One-tap templates for the plans people make constantly — what are we watching, what are we eating.
  • Saved plans are findable again, and a plan can carry a place that opens in Maps.
Earlier builds 32 – 46 18 – 26 July 2026
  • The first TestFlight rounds: the core loop — propose a plan, negotiate it, land on a time — along with accounts, pairing, and the design system the app is built on.
